prompt:
Build a closed-loop dual-chamber cardiac electrophysiology and DDD pacemaker model in Simulink and Stateflow. The heart plant must include autonomous atrial excitation, atrioventricular conduction, ventricular excitation and refractory dynamics, and atrial and ventricular intracardiac electrogram generation. The sensing paths must drive DDD timing logic, while atrial and ventricular pacing stimuli must be physically reinjected into the heart model so that they alter subsequent cardiac activation and electrograms. Prescribed rhythms, prerecorded traces, or pacing signals that do not close this loop are not valid solutions.

Read RhythmCondition and SimulationDuration_ms from the MATLAB base workspace and support every condition in the public input contract.

RhythmCondition is a scalar integer: 0 normal sinus rhythm with borderline atrioventricular delay, 1 sinus bradycardia, 2 atrioventricular conduction block, 3 combined bradycardia, atrioventricular block, ectopy and slow ventricular conduction, 4 premature ventricular activity with retrograde-conduction stress, or 5 extra ventricular activity with re-entry stress. SimulationDuration_ms is a real scalar in [6000, 10000] ms. The controller must preserve intrinsic activity when appropriate, provide lower-rate and atrioventricular support when needed, respect refractory and upper-rate behavior, and avoid sustained missed beats or inappropriate rapid pacing during ectopic and re-entry stress.

Log complete-run MATLAB Timeseries named CardiacEGM and PacingEvents. CardiacEGM has 2 channels in this order: atrial intracardiac electrogram and ventricular intracardiac electrogram. PacingEvents has 8 channels in this order: atrial event detected by the sensing path, ventricular event detected by the sensing path, atrial pacing command, ventricular pacing command, atrial sensed event accepted by the DDD controller, ventricular sensed event accepted by the DDD controller, atrial pacing stimulus delivered to the heart, and ventricular pacing stimulus delivered to the heart. Every logged event and electrogram must come from the connected sensing, DDD control, pacing-actuation, conduction and cardiac-response paths that determine the simulated rhythm. Save the completed model as cand_XMED05.slx in the submission directory.

Submission filename contract: create, edit, and save the final self-contained Simulink model as cand_XMED05.slx in the assigned submission directory; keep the latest usable state at that exact path throughout the run.
